lead: Quranic studies in the morning, Islamic studies after the break.

grades.label: KG
grades.title: Kindergarten
grades.quran: Easy Steps to Quraan Recitation, Step 1
grades.memorize: Tasmia, Ta’awwudh, Shahada, Al-Fatihah, Al-Ikhlas, An-Nas
grades.studies: Iqra KG Fiqh & Ibadaat · Prophet stories: Adam to Ismail

grades.label: Gr 1
grades.title: Grade 1
grades.studies: We Are Muslims 1 · Our Religion is Islam · Prophets Yusuf to Isa

grades.label: Gr 2
grades.title: Grade 2
grades.quran: Easy Steps, Step 3 · Let’s Read & Write Arabic 2
grades.memorize: Al-Qadr, Al-Feel, An-Nasr, Al-Qari’ah · Our Book of Dua
grades.studies: Our Prophet: Makkah & Madinah · We Are Muslims 2

grades.label: Gr 3
grades.title: Grade 3
grades.quran: Easy Steps, Step 4 · finish Arabic 2 · reading fluently
grades.studies: Mercy to Mankind I (Makkah) · We Are Muslims 3

grades.label: Gr 4
grades.title: Grade 4
grades.quran: Easy Steps, Step 5 · Juz Amma Vol. 1
grades.memorize: Tashahhud, Durood, Qunoot · Al-Adiyat, Al-Humazah, Ad-Duha
grades.studies: Mercy to Mankind II (Madinah) · We Are Muslims 4 · Teachings of the Quran 2

grades.label: Gr 5
grades.title: Grade 5
grades.quran: Juz Amma Vol. 1 · Teachings of the Quran 3
grades.memorize: Az-Zalzalah, Al-Alaq, At-Takathur, Ayat al-Kursi · salah duas

grades.label: Gr 6
grades.title: Grade 6
grades.studies: Tahdhib & Akhlaq · Aqidah & Fiqh · A Study of Hadith (ch. 1–10)

grades.label: Gr 7
grades.title: Grade 7
grades.quran: Tafseer of Al-Hujurat · A Study of the Quran
grades.studies: A Study of Hadith (ch. 11–27) · The Sealed Nectar

grades.label: Gr 8
grades.title: Grade 8
grades.studies: Purification of the Heart · Islamic Manners · Muslim civilization

grades.label: Youth
grades.title: Youth Group (Grades 9–10)
grades.quran: Two-year cycle: Juz One, then Juz Two
grades.studies: Fiqh, halal & haram, Islamic & American Muslim history, life skills · separate boys’ and girls’ groups

milestones.what: Ready for high school and beyond
